about: ArticleMeta — the line under an article's title: what it is, when it was published (and updated), who wrote it, how long it takes, and what it is about. One row that wraps, as a list, so a screen read

type.about: What kind of piece it is ("Blog", "Report", "Podcast"), shown as a small label first.

date.about: When it was published, as an ISO date ("2026-09-08"). Goes in the time element's datetime.

dateLabel.about: The date in words, when the formatted one is not what you want ("Published this morning", "Autumn 2026"). The ISO date stays in the markup.

updated.about: When it last changed in substance, as an ISO date. Shown as "Updated …".

authors.about: Who wrote it, in byline order. Shown as "By A, B and C".

readingTime.about: How long it takes, as it should read: "6 min read", "24 min listen".

topics.about: What it is about. Chips when they go nowhere, links when each has a page.

locale.about: The locale the dates are written in.
